articles.title: ontoprune added to PyPI
articles.summary: OntoPrune is an innovative neuro-symbolic context pruning middleware designed for local Small Language Models (SLMs). It acts as a lightweight translator, transforming source code into minimal context contracts using ontological representations. This technology aims to enhance the efficiency and performance of SLMs by significantly reducing the contextual data they process, making them more resource-friendly for local deployments.

articles.title: Lanterns Finale Spoilers: Will We See Hal Jordan Again? Series Creative Team Weighs In
articles.summary: The television series "Lanterns" concluded its season with an introspective finale, delivering answers to its central mysteries, most notably identifying the killer of Hal Jordan. articles.title: Ames crater, once linked to a 470-million-year-old event, may be nearly 370 million years old
articles.summary: New zircon dating of Oklahoma's Ames crater suggests it is approximately 370 million years old, not the previously estimated 470 million years. This revised age places the impact event much closer to the Late Devonian extinction, a period of significant biodiversity loss. This research offers fresh insights into Earth's geological history and the potential links between cosmic impacts and major extinction events.

articles.title: Bouquet Fire Smoke and Triple-Digit Heat Pose Combined Threat for Santa Clarita Residents with Asthma or Heart Disease
articles.summary: Santa Clarita Valley residents faced dual health stressors as the Bouquet Fire ravaged over 1,000 acres in the Angeles National Forest northeast of Santa Clarita by early October. This significant natural disaster, compounded by another unspecified health concern, posed considerable challenges for the community, illustrating the multi-faceted impact of environmental events on public well-being.
